title: RCA: Duplicate Postpaid Billing Cycle Run (INC-2026-0163)
content:
RCA: Duplicate Postpaid Billing Cycle Run (INC-2026-0163)

Document ID: RCA_INC_2026_0163

Category: C04 — Billing & Invoices

Department: Billing

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Incident Reference

INC-2026-0163

Problem Statement

Approximately 12,000 postpaid customers were billed twice for the June cycle due to a duplicate batch-job execution.

Root Cause

A scheduler configuration change inadvertently left the previous month's billing job trigger active alongside the new one, causing the batch to fire twice for the same cycle.

Contributing Factors

Scheduler change was not validated against a full pre-production dry run covering trigger de-duplication.

Automated reconciliation alerting caught the issue only after the second run completed, not before.

Corrective Actions

Add a pre-execution duplicate-trigger check to the billing batch framework (target: 30 days).

Introduce a mandatory dry-run validation gate for all scheduler configuration changes affecting billing (target: 45 days).

Add a pre-completion alert threshold so duplicate runs are caught before charges are finalised, not only after.

Status

Action 1 completed; Actions 2-3 in progress; owner: Billing Engineering team.
